title: Stu: the rollout loop, generation by generation

validation.note: Fixed validation deals: seed 131, deal index from 0, the common bidder (both tables play the same contract, so the IMPs are card play). The same deals every round, so rounds and roles pair deal by deal. Collections never use seed 131.

opponents.label: Gen 8 card play
opponents.detail: 8p-32 with policy v4.1: the Gen 8 prototype's search. Not trained on Stu's games.

opponents.label: BEN (64)
opponents.detail: BEN's card play, 64 samples. Not trained on Stu's games.

roles.label: Net alone
roles.description: The round's net plays its top card at every trick: no search, no rollouts, no claims. The unamplified player; the loop is alive if this rises.

roles.label: Net + rollouts
roles.description: The net's top card through trick 6; from trick 7, rollouts on the same net (up to 4 candidates, up to 128 layouts, the net choosing every simulated card). No search, no claims. Amplification by rollouts alone.

roles.label: Stu
roles.description: The bot as it plays the loop (x8's 8Z settings): tricks 1-2 the Gen 8 search, 3-6 the search blended with rollouts, 7-13 rollouts alone, claims, declarer mixing. The round's net is the rollout net.

generations.label: Policy v4.1 (reference)
generations.note: The Gen 7-8 policy net the teachers used, for scale. Not a round of the loop.

generations.label: Stu 0
generations.note: Rollout net v2 inside x8's 8Z. Table net (candidates' prior, tricks 1-6) is policy v4.1. Every simulated seat is told both sides are 8s-32. Records keep every layout's result for every candidate from 09:09 UTC.

net.label: Rollout net v2 (768 wide, epoch 5)
net.data: every Gen 6-8 arena episode (about 66,000), every bot's decisions, with a vector for each side's bot
net.previous_label: policy v4.1 on the same rows

labels.r7-stu0: Rollout net v2 + rollouts from trick 7
